voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: One of Japan's most celebrated swords was last seen at a Tokyo police station. Nineteen forty-six.
The Honjo Masamune, made by the smith Masamune around thirteen hundred. Named a National Treasure in nineteen thirty-nine.
In December nineteen forty-five, under occupation orders, the Tokugawa family handed it in to police, with thirteen others.
In January, police passed the swords to an American soldier recorded as Sergeant Coldy Bimore. No one by that name has ever been identified.
Some believe it was destroyed. Some, that it went to America. It has never been found.
